title: The Next Evolution of DoorDash and Lyft: Save on Rides and Orders with One Membership
summary: DashPass members can link their accounts with Lyft to unlock Lyft Go at no additional cost, earning 8% credits back on Lyft rides to use on DoorDash or Lyft, plus additional ride perks
body_markdown:
We’re always looking for new ways to bring our DashPass members even more value, convenience, and rewards. Today, we’re thrilled to announce the next evolution of our partnership with Lyft. Starting today, U.S. DashPass members will be able to seamlessly[link their accounts](http://www.doordash.com/lyft) with Lyft to claim Lyft Go, Lyft’s new premier rideshare membership valued at $9.99 per month, at no additional cost.


The same DashPass membership you use to save on your favorite neighborhood restaurants, groceries, essentials and more, now brings you exclusive perks on your daily commute or weekend rides.


### Earn 8% Lyft Credits Back on Rides, Redeemable on DoorDash or Lyft


For current DashPass users who have already linked their accounts to Lyft, you will need to claim Lyft Go in the DoorDash app. New users only need to link their accounts to Lyft to activate Lyft Go. From there, you’ll earn 8% back in credits on Lyft rides, from Wait & Save rides all the way to Lyft Black rides.


You can apply your 8% credits back to future DoorDash orders or your next Lyft ride. Whether a weekend errand helps pay for your lunch, or a trip to the airport helps put dinner on the table tomorrow, the value of your membership now travels with you.


> “At DoorDash, we're always looking for new ways to deepen the value we bring to our members. Millions of people already count on DashPass to save on dinner, groceries, and retail, and our continued partnership with Lyft takes that even further, turning your everyday rides into everyday rewards.With a ride now earning you credits toward your next order, it's just one more way DashPass is becoming your all-access pass to everyday life, helping you save on what matters most.” — Rob Edell, VP of DashPass, DoorDash


> "Lyft is already part of millions of people’s everyday lives. Now we’re showing up for more of the moments that matter. With Lyft Go, your ride to work or your ride home from the airport can help cover the cost of dinner. Together with DoorDash we’ve created a best-in-class membership program that raises the bar for the industry." — Siddharth Patil, Chief Rideshare Officer, Lyft


### Introducing In-Ride Ordering


Lyft is also making it easier to skip the wait for your next meal. On select trips, riders can browse nearby DoorDash restaurants right in the Lyft app and start an order before their ride even ends, no membership required. By the time they walk through the door, dinner is already on its way.


**Plus, Additional Rideshare Benefits** Along with earning 8% credits back to use across both platforms, DashPass members who link their accounts will also enjoy the full suite of Lyft Go benefits, including:


-


**Relaxed Cancellations** : Get three relaxed ride cancellations per month, giving you a little more wiggle room for when life happens.


-


**Automatic Donation Matching** : Make more change with your spare change. When you opt in to Lyft’s Round Up & Donate feature to support a cause of your choice, Lyft will match 100% of your charitable donation, doubling your impact.


-


**Lost Item Fee Waiver** : Never pay a fee if you leave an item behind, with unlimited uses.


### How to Get Started


Beginning Nov. 5, 2026, existing DashPass members can simply navigate to[https://www.doordash.com/dashpass/partner/lyft](https://www.doordash.com/dashpass/partner/lyft) claim Lyft Go, and start earning 8% credits back.


Not a DashPass member yet? Riders who sign up for Lyft Go directly for $9.99 a month can navigate to the Lyft Go membership hub to activate their complimentary DashPass, a benefit worth up to $120 a year, unlocking $0 delivery fees, reduced service fees, and exclusive savings on eligible DoorDash orders.
